brief:
Israeli military forces demolished the family home of Palestinian detainee Dawwas Hassoun in Beit Imrin, northwest of Nablus, early Thursday, IMEMC News reported. The demolition occurred months after Hassoun's detention on allegations related to a fatal attack.

The operation took place before dawn in the northern occupied West Bank. Israeli authorities have not provided further details regarding the specific allegations against Hassoun or the circumstances surrounding the demolition.
